snippet.title: Grind Survivors - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥WISHLIST HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816930/
Grind Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike where towering demon hunters battle endless waves of hellish enemies. Featuring brutal bullet-hell combat, dynamic character builds, and procedurally generated loot and weapons, it blends the thrill of survivor gameplay with deep looter-shooter progression in a scorched, demon-infested world. #indiegame

Assemble Entertainment is an independent game publisher based in Wiesbaden, Germany. Founded in 2016 by industry veteran Stefan Marcinek, Assemble is known for critically acclaimed indie hits such as Sticky Business, Roadwarden, Lacuna and Asgard's Fall. The company also owns in-house developer Gentlymad Studios, creators of the Endzone franchise. Assemble has twice won the German Developer Award for “Best Publisher” and organizes GermanDevDays, one of Germany’s largest developer conferences. Learn more at www.assembleteam.com and www.germandevdays.com. #assembleentertainment
